verdict.rationale: Mercury publishes a comprehensive, versioned REST API (accounts, cards, transactions, invoices, payments, treasury) with interactive docs, OAuth2 and scoped API tokens, a sandbox environment, an official Go SDK, and an official CLI (verified via probe) covering the full resource surface — clearly documented and independently confirmed as working. It also explicitly caters to AI agents via llms.txt, agent skills repo, and a hosted MCP server. missing for 10: no publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec (confirmed gated to admin-only) and no official Python/Node SDKs, only community packages.
